response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks explicit executive-level leadership experience, fintech-specific domain knowledge, and a proven track record in scaling engineering organizations or operating AI systems in regulated environments.
strengths: Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and tooling (e.g., MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq).
Deep technical expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and real-time data processing (e.g., micro-services at Sociomantic, GISCollective).
Proven ability to design and maintain complex, scalable platforms (e.g., GISCollective, open-source contributions).
concerns: No explicit CTO or executive leadership experience; current roles are primarily technical (Staff/Senior Engineer).
Limited fintech-specific experience (e.g., credit systems, regulatory compliance, real-time risk modeling).
No demonstrated track record of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or developing senior technical leadership layers.
